## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant manual or provider-backed flows were checked

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a documented reason why it cannot be automated
- [ ] Route and API compatibility is preserved or migration steps are documented
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, production payloads, or private evidence are included
- [ ] Required Supabase or environment changes are documented
